Rows of the Derivative of a Block

Source: R/plot_smooth.R
design_derivative.Rd

Computes the derivative of order order with respect to var of every row of the block of a term at the rows of grid, by one central finite-difference stencil of accuracy four on the rows that modelterms7::term_predict() returns.

Usage

design_derivative(tm, grid, var, order, lo, hi)

Arguments

tm

A built modelterms7::SmoothTerm.

grid

A data frame with every variable the term reads.

var

The variable that is differentiated.

order

The order of the derivative.

lo, hi

The range of the variable.

Value

A matrix with one row for each row of grid and one column for each coefficient of the term.

Details

The step is \(h = 0.05\,\mathrm{fd\_step}(1, m, 4)\,(b - a)\), where \(m\) is the order and \([a, b]\) the range of the variable. The center of the stencil is moved inside \([a + rh, b - rh]\), where \(r\) is the reach of the stencil, and the weights of the shifted nodes are computed for the point itself, so that the nodes stay inside the range over which the basis is defined.
